content.short: Book hotels and flights with Bitcoin, Ethereum or stablecoins, built for people who live on-chain.
content.description: TravelSwap searches hotels, resorts, rentals and flights, with flight data from Duffel and hotel inventory from Expedia Partner Solutions, and lets travellers pay with BTC, ETH, USDC, USDT or a card. It highlights stays near crypto events such as TOKEN2049 and Korea Blockchain Week, and a Pro membership with extra rewards is on the way.
content.meta: Book hotels and flights with BTC, ETH, USDC or USDT on TravelSwap, with stays near major crypto events.
